scope: These results apply to the maintained kit fixtures and the component gallery in headless Chromium on macOS. 1.2.0 adds dialog layout attributes, a period density, behaviour changes to menus and controls, two warn-only lints and the period evidence register. The new menu behaviour (arrow keys stopping on unavailable commands, the 400 ms submenu rest) is covered by tests but has not been judged in use by a person. The generated Electron editor was not built, packaged or launched. Consumer applications, native window behavior on any operating system, OS display scaling and screen readers require their own checks.

windows_95_comparison.reference: Windows 95 4.00.1111 C (OSR2.5) installed from the owner's media in QEMU, captured 19 November 2026 at 24-bit, 16-bit and 256 colours by tools/win95-reference
windows_95_comparison.result: At 24-bit, of 54 paired control states: 21 match pixel for pixel, 17 have the same edges at a different size, 6 differ in size and were not compared pixel by pixel, 10 differ in drawing.
windows_95_comparison.scope: Compared with the comfortable atlas before the density switch was merged; the period density was compared with the capture control by control by its own author, not re-run here. user, gdi and their 32-bit counterparts report version 4.0.0.950, as in the 1995 release; comctl32 is 4.70 (1996), so status bar, tab, slider and progress results describe that library. The original August 1995 release was not captured, and no toolbar was captured. Captures are not distributed.
